subject: MCPRouter.Shell.Live.Lifecycle.LogonTaskSupervisor, the "restarts on crash" claim
writer: schtasks.exe /Create /XML, with the document the shipped supervisor built
recorders: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo - the Task Scheduler WMI provider, for LastRunTime and LastTaskResult
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process - the operating system process table, for the process identity
reason: the planted defect - the RestartOnFailure-only document the product wrote until 2026-09-03 - broke LIVE.restarted and nothing else. The restart assertion is watching the scheduler and not restating the config.

arms.what: neither task is registered and no witness daemon is running before this run
arms.detail: so every process and every run time below belongs to this run

arms.what: the recorder reports the product registration present
the logon trigger carries a repetition, which is what restarts a crashed daemon
the instances policy discards a repetition that fires while the daemon is alive
the scheduler starts the daemon when the trigger fires
the process table stops reporting the daemon, and the scheduler records the run as failed
the scheduler brings the daemon back after it dies
arms.detail: first pid=3488 at 9/3/2026 3:20:08 AM; second pid=<none> at <none>; waited up to 210s

arms.what: both recorders report absence once the tasks are removed and the daemon is stopped
arms.detail: both recorders can say no, so their yes above was a reading

writerSelfReportIsNotEvidence: the daemon's own append-only run log. Graded by nothing here: a process reporting its own start is the writer reporting on itself. It is carried so a reader can see whether it agrees with the two recorders that did the grading.
substitution: the live task carries a TimeTrigger where the product writes a LogonTrigger, because a trigger repetition does not apply to an on-demand start and this lane must not log the machine out. Every Setting, the repetition interval, the principal, the action and the instances policy are the product's own document, unmodified.
notMeasured: that the trigger fires AT LOGON - this lane does not log the user out, and DEF-081 keeps that half

that the daemon under supervision is the router daemon - the payload is app/windows/MCPRouter.Witness.Daemon, a harness binary that starts, records its own start and waits to be killed, because this tree's router daemon is TypeScript under Node rather than a Windows executable a Task Scheduler action can name
notes: ARMING RUN: the live task is registered from the product document with its Repetition block removed - the exact registration this product shipped until 2026-09-03. Exactly LIVE.restarted is required to break. A run in this mode that reports PASS has shown the restart assertion cannot fail, which is a defect in this lane and not in the product.
